typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		WF_GUID as string,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		DISCOVERED_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		DISCOVERED_PUBLISHER as string,
		DISCOVERED_VERSION as string,
		INSTALL_DATE as timestamp,
		DEVICE_GUID as string,
		INSTALLED_ON as string,
		PACKAGE_NAME as string,
		U_VENDOR_END_OF_LIFE as timestamp,
		U_TSC_OBSOLETE_DATE as timestamp,
		U_WF_EXTENDED_SUPPORT_DATE as timestamp,
		U_WELLS_FARGO_RETIREMENT_DATE as timestamp,
		U_TSC_LIFECYCLE as string,
		U_TSC_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		U_VENDOR_END_OF_LIFE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ImportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		U_WF_EXTENDED_SUPPORT_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		U_TSC_OBSOLETE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DISCOVERED_VERSION as string,
		DEVICE_GUID as string,
		U_TSC_LIFECYCLE as string,
		DISCOVERED_PUBLISHER as string,
		DISCOVERED_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		U_WELLS_FARGO_RETIREMENT_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		U_TSC_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		WF_GUID as string,
		INSTALL_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		INSTALLED_ON as string,
		PACKAGE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		U_VENDOR_END_OF_LIFE,
		ImportDate,
		U_WF_EXTENDED_SUPPORT_DATE,
		U_TSC_OBSOLETE_DATE,
		DISCOVERED_VERSION,
		DEVICE_GUID,
		U_TSC_LIFECYCLE,
		DISCOVERED_PUBLISHER,
		DISCOVERED_PRODUCT_NAME,
		U_WELLS_FARGO_RETIREMENT_DATE,
		U_TSC_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		WF_GUID,
		INSTALL_DATE,
		INSTALLED_ON,
		PACKAGE_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
